metaDescription: WordPress and WooCommerce site for Holloway Diamonds, a Melbourne jeweler: an online jewelry shop, engagement ring menus and showroom appointment booking.
summary: WordPress and WooCommerce website for a Melbourne diamond jeweler with three showrooms.
overview: Holloway Diamonds is a Melbourne jeweler with showrooms in Armadale, Brighton and Canterbury, focused on natural diamond engagement rings and fine jewelry. Pixel2Tech built Holloway Diamonds' WordPress website as white-label development partner for a digital agency. The site pairs an online jewelry shop on WooCommerce with appointment booking for the showrooms.
challenge: Diamond jewelry is a considered purchase: some customers buy online, while many want to see a ring in person or have one made. The agency's client needed one site that serves both, with a deep catalog that can be browsed by style, shape, color and gemstone, and clear routes to three showrooms.
approach: A mega menu breaks engagement rings down by style, shape, color and gemstone, and jewelry by category and curated collection. The header keeps all three showroom phone numbers and a Make an Appointment button on every page, and the hero offers an Ideal Scope appointment next to the main call to action. Services such as custom-made jewelry, remodeling and the diamond upgrade program, plus diamond education pages, have their own menu sections.
outcome: A WordPress site where buyers can shop jewelry online, read up on diamonds or book a showroom visit, with the same paths on desktop and mobile. New pieces and collections are added through WooCommerce, so the catalog can grow with the range.
deliverables: Engagement ring and jewelry mega menu

process.title: Catalog structure
process.body: Engagement rings are organized by style, shape, color and gemstone, and jewelry by category, from rings and earrings to tennis jewelry and curated collections, all reachable from one mega menu.

process.title: Online shop
process.body: WooCommerce runs the product pages, cart and checkout, with live product search and a wishlist so buyers can shortlist pieces before deciding.

process.title: Showroom booking
process.body: Phone numbers for Armadale, Brighton and Canterbury and a Make an Appointment button stay in the header, so an in-person visit is always one step away.

process.title: Services and education
process.body: Custom-made jewelry, remodeling, the diamond upgrade program and diamond education content each have their own pages, along with FAQs and a buying guide on the home page.

whyItMatters: With high-value jewelry, the website often decides whether a buyer orders online or visits a showroom. Giving both paths equal weight serves buyers at either stage.

faqs.q: What platform is the Holloway Diamonds website built on?
faqs.a: It runs on WordPress with the Divi theme, and WooCommerce powers the online shop, cart, product search and wishlist.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build stores and websites under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
